rationales.LC: The attacker's chat message is matched by regex and directly drives the scripted reply that lists the knowledge base documents, with no independent transformation reducing language to validated fields (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:301-332, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1285-1290).
rationales.CP: RAGBot answers only the latest user turn; the knowledge base is static with no ingestion path, and cross-session persistence exists only in MemoryBot (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:327-331, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1841-1848).
rationales.AP: The effect is confined to the RAGBot reply; no handoff or cross-principal propagation is implemented (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1711-1770).
rationales.RH: No evaluator, verifier or reward channel is on the path; the reply is a scripted chat response and no reward-hacking episode is documented (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/agent-success-paths.js:72-106).
rationales.ES: RAGBot's only declared tool is a scripted outbound call, and no dynamic or unvetted extension is bound on the assessed path (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:301-376).

score.automatable_rationale: The exploit is a single unauthenticated chat message to a deterministic regex-driven handler, so it can be issued programmatically without human interaction.
score.technical_impact_rationale: The reply discloses internal knowledge base documents including an admin password and an SSN, but no integrity or availability impact is demonstrated.

applicability_as_implemented.rationale: In the default simulated mode no model is called; the handler matches regexes and returns a scripted reply, so there is no model-directed goal pursuit or action selection.

applicability_as_modeled.rationale: The lab documents the RAGBot path as retrieving internal documents whose planted instructions are inserted into the prompt and executed, which models model-directed goal pursuit and action selection.
